ratings.comment: Passionate professor, you won't regret his class! Lectures can be dense since slides don't cover everything, but he offers lots of extra credit and grades lightly. Only a couple straightforward research assignments (as of Fall 2025) to manage, an easy midterm, and a final project. He likes to use AI images in slides, and in projects which is funny.
Super easy grader, and very understanding when I misunderstood a project assignment.
